headline: Argentina Edge England 2-1 in a Semi-Final Classic
whyCareReason: History, heat and a final place on the line: England vs Argentina in a World Cup semi-final.
teaser: Argentina staged a late comeback to beat England 2-1 and book a return to the World Cup final.
story:
The semi-final carried every layer of history the rivalry always brings. England led and looked set to manage the night, until Argentina's champion instinct flipped the script in the closing stages.

Two late goals completed the comeback. England still threatened in the final minutes, but Argentina's game management and quality in the box proved decisive once more.

At 2-1 the holders were finalists again. England drop into the third-place play-off after a campaign that reached the last four.
stakes: A place in the 2026 World Cup final. The loser plays for bronze.
rivalryAngle: One of football's most loaded fixtures: 1986 ghosts, 1998 red cards, 2002 penalties, and a 2026 semi-final chapter.
funFacts: This was the first England-Argentina World Cup semi-final meeting.
Argentina are aiming to become the first side to retain the World Cup since Brazil in 1962.
Hard Rock Stadium hosted a full-capacity night for the last four.

keyPlayers.name: Lautaro Martínez
keyPlayers.hook: The focal point of Argentina's finishing when the game opened up.

keyPlayers.name: Jude Bellingham
keyPlayers.hook: England's engine room and the man most likely to force chaos in the box.

headToHead: World Cup meetings between England and Argentina are rarely quiet. History hangs over every challenge and every set piece.
